Masonry

Giving shape to your spaces.

A room to rethink, a wall to build, a space to transform. Masonry lays the foundations of your project, whether you are building or renovating.

Discuss your building project

Start with what is there. Build what comes next.

Every job begins with an understanding of the building and how you use it. We discuss your needs to define the masonry works that suit your project.

  • General masonry works
  • New walls and alterations to existing walls
  • Masonry features and alterations
  • Renovation of existing buildings

The feasibility, scope and conditions of the works will be defined after your project has been assessed.

Before
you begin.

Can an existing wall be altered?+

Feasibility depends on the building’s structure and the wall’s function. A site visit and, where necessary, a structural assessment establish the conditions for the works.

What do you need to assess my project?+

Tell us the town, the type of works, approximate dimensions and any known constraints. Plans or photographs may also be useful when we discuss your project.
